title: The gate refuses a change that removes or changes a public extension entry since the last ext tag without a major API version, a deprecation and a changelog entry
goal: kbext.surface_breaks(old, new) lists each public entry removed, renamed or with a changed signature between two surfaces; a break passes only when new's API_VERSION has a higher major than old's and the entry was marked deprecated in a minor release the old surface came from (the deprecation window of this story's gate), and every API_VERSION change has a kb/_self/extension-changelog.md entry. kbext.py lint reads the surface at the newest ext-v* tag (none: one line, exit 0) and at the working tree, prints each break, exit 1; kbgit.py sync --push runs it when a changed path is under _tools/. kbext.deprecated(name, since, removed_in) warns once per process, on stderr, when a deprecated entry is used.

run:
import sys,copy; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kbext
old=copy.deepcopy(kbext.surface()); new=copy.deepcopy(old)
new["points"]=[p for p in new["points"] if p["name"]!="lane"]
assert kbext.surface_breaks(old,new), "removing lane at the same major passed"
maj=int(old["api_version"].split(".")[0]); new["api_version"]=str(maj+1)+".0.0"
for p in old["points"]:
    p.update(deprecated_in=old["api_version"]) if p["name"]=="lane" else None
assert kbext.surface_breaks(old,new)==[], kbext.surface_breaks(old,new)

gates.question: How long must a public extension entry stay deprecated before a major API version may remove it?
gates.reason: a group then sees the stderr warning and the changelog entry on its next minor pull, before the major that removes it; longer windows slow the shared tools without a second signal
